clues.text: In Joseph's first dream, his brothers' bundles of grain gathered around his own and bowed down to it.
Boaz's foreman said the Moabitess had asked to glean and gather among these, following after the harvesters.
Job spoke of naked poor people who carry these in the fields but still go hungry.
A song of ascents says one who goes out weeping with seed will return joyfully carrying these.
A psalmist prays that Zion's haters be like rooftop grass, too scant to fill arms that bind these.
Micah said nations massed against Zion did not know the LORD had gathered them like these to the threshing floor.
Zechariah foretold that Judah's clans would be like a flaming torch among these, consuming the peoples around.
